- Finance owner: copying in Rajiv (Platform lead) and I’ll introduce our Finance sponsor (Alicia Torres) after I confirm her availability — she typically handles contract sign-off for POCs.

Thanks Marissa — noted. I pulled together the minimal vendor packet and a one-page vendor profile draft (see stubs below). I’ll circulate the actual files once we finalize internal approvals.

Procurement packet (minimum) for Acme:
- Vendor profile (company overview, contact, NAICS)
- W9 / tax form (US) or W8 if needed
- Standard DPA (we can use Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) — commercial general liability + cyber liability
- Reference customer list (2–3 customers)

Commercial defaults for a POC:
- Term: 30 days / POC period (pilot)
- Payment: Net30 via PO, invoiced to Accounts Payable (AP contact to be provided by Acme)
- Pricing: pilot credit $10k (one-time) + usage thereafter at list (we can discuss discounting if needed)

I’ll prep the vendor profile and COI and share via Drive link by EOD. If Sarah can get Alicia’s email, I’ll draft a short intro email for approvals.
